description: Implementation of TaxRateDao for accessing tax rate data from the database, including methods for listing, retrieving by code or ID, and filtering by store, country, zone, and tax class.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for TaxRate entity, providing database access methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of TaxRate objects for a given store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its code for a specific store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
